title: Move the tag explorer into its own container with a snapshot-only mount
description: The host explorer runs as a thread inside `plexdb schedule`, in a container that mounts /data read-write; only the read-only open keeps it off the live store. A second container, plexdb-explore, mounting just the snapshot directory read-only removes that possibility outright. Blocked on admin-project-tool supporting more than one [docker_run] container per admin.toml.

title: Tag explorer: tag table with counts, IDF and co-tags, plus every title tagged X
description:
First end-to-end slice. `plexdb explore` (plexdb/commands/explore.py) serves one page and JSON endpoints on localhost:5194; `admin explore` launches it.

Table: every tmdb_keywords value with its document count, IDF = 1 + ln(N / df) (the formula taste-cosine.rhai uses), and the tags it most often co-occurs with. A Movies/Shows toggle picks the corpus; N = titles of that type carrying at least one tmdb_keywords row (10,696 movies, 1,534 shows on the 12 Aug copy). Sortable, filterable. Clicking a tag lists the titles carrying it.

Each row has a noise checkbox saved in browser localStorage, and a button copies the checked tags as a JSON array. Nothing is written to disk.
close_reason: Tag table, drill-down and noise list shipped and verified on a fresh pull

title: Tag explorer: serve it from the host container
description: `plexdb schedule` starts the explorer's HTTP server on a background thread when PLEXDB_EXPLORE_PORT is set. Each request re-opens /snapshot/plexdb.snapshot.db read-only, so the nightly publish shows up without a restart (publish renames atomically). One [[docker_run.ports]] entry in admin.toml, bound to ${PLEXDB_EXPLORE_BIND} from /boot/config/plexdb.env; no auth in the app. The deploy itself waits for the owner's go.
notes: Code landed in 6e56a91 and checked in a local amd64 container (503 before publish, 200 after). Open until deployed: needs PLEXDB_EXPLORE_BIND and PLEXDB_EXPLORE_PORT in /boot/config/plexdb.env, then admin deploy.
close_reason: Deployed 02:56 UTC: container serves the explorer on 100.114.249.118:5194 over the snapshot; 200 with 10,890 movies, 19,602 tags

title: Tag explorer: a web GUI over tmdb_keywords
description:
A browser view of the keywords the store holds, to find tags that describe packaging rather than theme (duringcreditsstinger rides along with superhero films and inflates taste-cosine.rhai's match) and to see how tags group titles into zones.

Read-only throughout: served by `plexdb explore` through `store.open_readonly`, built on the stdlib `http.server` with no new dependency. Runs locally against ./data/plexdb.db and on the host against the published snapshot.

Done when the four views below ship.
close_reason: All four views shipped: table, host serving, graph, map
